notes: Fixed the token_set_ratio bug per PLAN_v2's open blocker with content-word coverage (brain/coverage.py): tokenize query, drop stopwords, per-task word-level fuzzy match (stdlib difflib.SequenceMatcher, threshold 0.85) against that task's display_name + canonical_task_id + aliases tokens, coverage = fraction of query content words matched, abstain threshold 0.8. No rapidfuzz/thefuzz install needed -- stdlib difflib is sufficient and this is word-level, not the broken whole-string token_set_ratio approach. Verified emergent (not special-cased): 'flip' scores <0.85 against every one of the 50 real tasks' vocab words (test_flip_never_matches_emergently), and a source-scan test asserts no canonical_task_id string literals appear in decide.py/coverage.py. brain/test_decide.py covers: bottle flip abstains ('flip' uncovered); all 3 bottle tasks (bottle-cleaning, bottle-surface-buffing, water-filtration-bottle-filling) match themselves and do not abstain (the regression guard for the bug); one near-miss spelling ('buttonhole stiching' typo -> buttonhole-stitching, difflib ratio 0.941); gibberish abstains. The full variance/results/variance.json from Agent A was NOT YET PRESENT when the suite was built (polled coordination/status/A.json, state=running throughout, plus a bounded ~3 min additional wait) -- built and unit-tested the abstain tier first from metadata alone, then implemented act/ask tier logic (family_confounded/camera_confounded gating, perm_p<=0.05 threshold, cluster sizes from labels) against a hand-written fixture at brain/fixtures/variance_fixture.json. UPDATE: after the suite passed, Agent A's own smoke-test artifact variance/results/smoke_variance.json appeared (its 3-task subset, real schema incl. an extra 'method' field my code correctly ignores) -- ran decide.py against it directly (not my fixture) for 'axle shaft cutting' (perm_p=0.169>0.05, not confounded -> correctly tier=act) and 'belly band assembly' (camera_confounded=true -> correctly gated to tier=act despite low-ish perm_p); both matched expectations, giving real cross-agent schema validation beyond the fixture. The FULL 50-task variance.json (Agent A's final output, not the 3-task smoke subset) is still not present as of this write -- recommend re-running brain/test_decide.py plus a manual decide.py check against the full file once Agent A reaches state=done. --include-live reads feedback/live_index.json defensively (tested via fixture; real file from Agent E not yet present, confirmed CLI does not crash on its absence).
